title: Hawaii Leads US in Life Expectancy
paragraphs: If you want to live a long life in the United States, Hawaii may be the best place to live. According to official data from the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), Hawaii has the highest life expectancy of any state.

The data comes from the CDC's National Center for Health Statistics, which publishes reports on life expectancy in each state. According to its most recent state-by-state report, which uses data from 2022, a baby born in Hawaii could expect to live for 80 years on average.
Hawaii was followed by Massachusetts, with a life expectancy of 79.8 years, and New Jersey, with 79.6 years. New York and Connecticut completed the top five, with 79.5 and 79.4 years.

At the other end of the list was West Virginia, where life expectancy was just 72.2 years. That means there was a difference of almost eight years between the states with the highest and lowest life expectancy. Mississippi had the second-lowest life expectancy, at 72.6 years, followed by Kentucky, at 73.6 years.
Hawaii also came first for people who are already older. A 65-year-old in Hawaii could expect to live another 20.5 years, compared with 16.6 years in West Virginia.
The report also had some good news. In 2022, life expectancy rose in 48 states and in Washington, DC. Life expectancy had fallen in many states during the COVID-19 pandemic.
The report also found that women live longer than men in every state. The difference ranged from 3.6 years in Utah to 6.9 years in New Mexico.
Hawaii has been at the top of this list before. In a similar CDC report using data from 2018, Hawaii also had the highest life expectancy, at 81 years, while West Virginia had the lowest.
